correctness.rationale: The ideal/filter cross-order criterion is necessary and sufficient for a one-point extension in the random poset. By the first missing a_i, one-sided ideals contribute (1+u)^{n-1} sum_{i=0}^{n-1}u^i+u^n(1+u)^n; by the first chosen upper b_j, two-sided profiles contribute v(1+v)^{n-j}((1+u)^j-1). These classes are disjoint except for the single empty profile, yielding the exact polynomial and total. Conditioned classes give uniform cut indices plus binomials; coupling establishes O(n^-1/2) W1 (an O(1/n) exceptional mass). The limiting mixture has EX=3/8, EX²=5/16, EXY=1/48; covariance -23/192, variance 11/64 and correlation -23/33. An independent exhaustive enumeration of all ternary profiles for n=1..4 checked the full bivariate polynomial coefficientwise. This does not prove the all-n result; the combinatorial partition and coupling do.
